note.p: Ed Pope Notes: Gould 26.8.1797 calls / 27.8.1797 again / 7.7.1800 at Gould's (in Ireland). In Godwin's 1796 list for 1800 / 13.7.1800 at Grattan's / 14.7.1800 again (?) / 15.7.1800 dines at Curran's and sleeps / 16.7.1800 at Reeves's / 20.7.1800 at Webb's / 26.7.1800 at Curran's / 8.10.1800 (in London) meet Goold, Dogherty, Burne / 11.10 meet Goold and Dogherty / 18.10.1800 meet Goold / 13.1.1803 Goold adv at Perry's / 2.11.1833 Gould adv at theatre
Thomas Goold DNB 1766-1846 may have been all the above entries except the first two (before the 1796 list entry) and the last. For other possibilities see work notes below

Work notes Edward Thoroton Gould colonel of Notts militia of Paris France will PCC 1831 married 12.12.1791 Ann Dormer, sister of Robert Knight's wife, was witness in Knight's crim con trial vs Col Fuller 1805 / William Gould printer Cope St Dublin / 1798 subscr to D R O'Conor James Goold Cloghakilty, Cork, and Francis, George, Edmond and Henry Goold, Cork / Geo Goold, Old Court, co. Cork = May 1802 Lady Charlotte Brown bau of Earl of Kenmare / Dublin Trades 1797 Eleanor Goold china and delph seller / Holdens 1805 London Francis Goold Esq, Dover St
